title: Splice
description: A quarter-inch tape splicing block with the playback head beside it. Rock the tape across the head to find the beat, press the razor into the 45° slot, butt reel B against your cut and rub a splicing tab down, then play it: the beat jumps exactly where you cut.
intent: One editing ritual finished to the edge: the tape is the timeline, the razor is the edit, and the sound you hear is whatever oxide is crossing the head gap, so a diagonal cut really crossfades.
